title: Geotech Reference Chapter
description: Schema for structured chapter text JSON files used by geotech_references._retrieval. Mirrors the format established by gec_7/text/chapterNN.json.

volume.description: Volume number for multi-volume references; null if single-volume.

chapter.description: Chapter number. For prologue or front-matter, use 0.

section_id.description: Hierarchical section identifier, the only one with that value in the whole reference. FHWA/GEC dot form ('5.7.2', '7.2.1.3.1'), UFC hyphen-then-dot form ('4-1', '4-2.1.1'), prologue ('P.1', 'P-1'), an appendix or annex by its letter ('A', 'B-3.4', 'D.3'), a lettered part of a section split to fit the reference tools ('D.15.a'), a Part's numeral before the number where the print restarts its chapters in each Part ('II-2.3.5'), or the paragraph numbers of a manual in the Army layout ('5-5a(2)(b)', '2-7a(2)(c)1', EM 1110-1-1905). Mirrors SECTION_ID in _schema.py.

summary.description: Optional 300-500 char summary of the section's content, returned by default from reference_search. Engineers and agents get this compact version first; the full body is only loaded via reference_get when they commit to reading a specific section. A section without one is found by its title and body.

body.description: Long-form narrative text from the source document. Container sections (whose children appear later in the same chapter) may legitimately have empty bodies.

id.description: Equation label as it appears in the source (e.g., 'Eq. 5-12').

formula.description: Optional: the equation as printed, typed in by hand from the printed page in plain text (Unicode symbols, ^ for a power, √ for a root), e.g. 'βi = 1.5 – 0.135 √zi   with 1.2 > βi > 0.25'. A misprint is typed as printed and said in notes.

variables.description: Optional: each symbol of formula with its meaning and units as the page defines it.

notes.description: Optional remarks on the equation as printed (a misprint kept as printed, a symbol the page does not define).

source.description: Optional: where formula was typed in from, e.g. 'Typed in from p. 9-132.'

implemented_in.description: Dotted path to the digitized Python function (e.g., 'dm7_1.chapter5.primary_consolidation_settlement_nc'), or null if not yet digitized.

oneOf.description: String summary form (legacy, used by gec_12 deep subsections).

items.description: Figure reference and caption (e.g., 'Figure 5-3: Compression curve construction').

applicability.description: One-sentence description of when this section applies.

subsections.description: Optional nested subsections (used by gec_12 for deep hierarchies). A nested subsection needs section_id, title and body; the other fields are optional and default to its section's.
